title: Listen and Choose a Response：听一句，选怎么接
goal: 一句话只听一遍，八题里答对六题以上：听出对方是在问、在请求、在提议还是在抱怨，否定疑问和客气的绕弯说法不上当。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

cards.title: 这道题是什么

rows.v: 听力部分四类题之一，15–19 题，是听力里题数最多的一类。
你听到一句问话或陈述，它是一小段对话的前半句。这句话只能听，屏幕上不显示。然后你读四个书面的回应，选最合适的一个。
和校园生活有关的简短对话。
常用词和套语；简单的语法结构，包括各种问句的构成；短对话里什么样的回应在社交上是得体的；辨音，以及用语调和重音表达的意思；推断言外之意、说话人的身份或场合。
官方标的范围是 A1 到 B2。
47 题，约 29 分钟，分两段自适应。每段录音只放一遍。说话人有北美、英国、澳大利亚三种口音。
rows.src: spec 第 1、4、11 页；overview 第 8 页；lessonplan 第 7 页

cards.note: 官方说明里特别提到：选对回应既要听懂字面意思，也要听懂言外之意。

cards.title: 前半句是什么，后半句就该是什么
cards.intro: 对话是一对一对的：问配答，请求配答应或推辞，提议配接受或谢绝。先判断听到的那句话在做什么，四个选项里只有一个是配得上的。
rows: 问信息
Where / When / How long / What did you think of ...?
直接给那一种信息：地点、时间、时长、看法
给了另一种信息：问 when 答地点
绕弯问信息
Do you know when ...? / Can you tell me where ...?
同上，给信息
只回答字面：Yes, I do.
请求
Could you ...? / Would you mind ...? / I was wondering if you could ...
答应或推辞：Sure. / Not at all. / I'm afraid I can't.
把它当成问能力或问过去的事
提议、建议
Why don't we ...? / How about ...? / Do you want me to ...?
接受或谢绝：Sounds good. / That would be great. / I'd rather not.
用 Because 讲原因
讲一个麻烦
I can't get this printer to work.
出主意或表示同情
重复对方句子里的词
道谢、道歉、祝贺
Thanks for ... / Sorry I'm late. / Congratulations!
套语：No problem. / Don't worry about it. / Thanks!
答错了套语：对道歉说 You're welcome.
求证
..., aren't you? / ..., right? / Didn't you say ...?
确认或纠正，常带一句补充
把它当成第一次听说的新问题
cards.src: 「应答成对」的讲法来自 lessonplan 第 2 课；表里的例句是本课原创。

body.p: 下面三种句子字面和真正的意思不一样，是这类题最常设的坑。

list: 否定疑问：Didn't you say it was due Friday? 说话人以为是周五，在求证。回应要么确认，要么纠正，不能当成普通的 yes/no 问题乱答。
Would you mind ...? 问的是「你介意吗」。同意对方做，要说 Not at all；说 Yes 反而是介意。
Why don't we / Why don't you ...? 是建议，不是问原因。用 Because 开头的选项基本是错的。

compare.thin: Why don't we grab lunch before the seminar? — Because the seminar is at noon.
compare.full: Why don't we grab lunch before the seminar? — Sure, I'm starving.
compare.why: 对方在提议一起吃午饭，要回应的是去不去。

compare.thin: Do you know when the library closes? — Yes, I do.
compare.full: Do you know when the library closes? — At ten, I think.
compare.why: 对方要的是时间。只答 Yes 等于没回答。

cards.title: 只听一遍，抓什么

body.p: 一句话两三秒就过去了。不用每个词都听清，按顺序抓三样：

list: 开头一两个词：Where、When、How long、Could you、Why don't、Didn't。它们决定这句话是哪一种。
重读的词：英语里重读的是带信息的词。I can't get this PRINTER to WORK，抓住 printer 和 work 就够了。
句尾的语调：往上扬多半是在问或求证，往下落多半是陈述或特殊疑问句。陈述句用升调说出来（You're coming?）就是在问。

body.p: 录音放完再看选项会来不及。录音开始前先把四个选项扫一眼，心里有个数：它们是在给时间、给地点，还是在答应一件事。

cards.src: 重音和语调表达意思，见 lessonplan 第 4 课。

cards.title: 错项的四种样子
rows: 重复听到的词
听到 How long have you been waiting for the bus? 选项：It's a long bus.
同一个词出现在选项里不是加分项。先问它配不配得上。
答了另一个问题
问 Where can I pick up my ID? 选项：Tomorrow morning.
回到开头的疑问词。
只答字面
Do you know when ...? 选项：Yes, I do.
绕弯的问句要的是后半句的信息。
套语对错了场合
Sorry I'm late. 选项：You're welcome.
You're welcome 只配 Thanks。

lines.text: Do you know when the library closes tonight?

items.why: 绕弯问时间。B 只答了字面，C 答的是地点。

lines.text: Why don't we grab lunch before the seminar?

options: Because the seminar is at noon.
items.why: Why don't we 是提议。回应的是去不去。

lines.text: Would you mind if I opened the window?

options: The window is on the left.
No, I didn't mind it yesterday.
items.why: 问的是「你介意吗」。不介意说 Not at all。

lines.text: Didn't you say the assignment was due Friday?

options: No, I'll say it on Friday.
Yes, Friday is my favorite day.
I did, but the professor just extended it.
items.why: 否定疑问是在求证。D 先确认（I did），再补上新的情况。

lines.text: I can't get this printer to work.

options: Have you checked whether it's out of paper?
I work at the print shop.
It works for a large company.
items.why: 对方讲了一个麻烦，配得上的是出主意。C、D 只是重复了 work。

lines.text: Thanks for lending me your notes.

items.why: 道谢配套语。

lines.text: You're coming to the study session, aren't you?

options: I wish I could, but I have to work.
items.why: 反意疑问是在求证。I wish I could 是客气地说去不了。

lines.text: How long have you been waiting for the bus?

items.why: How long 加完成时，问到现在为止的时长。B 说的是将来的时间点。

lines.text: Where can I pick up my student ID?

options: At the registration office on the second floor.
items.why: Where 问地点。

lines.text: Could you keep an eye on my laptop for a minute?

options: I have an eye exam today.
items.why: keep an eye on 是「帮忙看着」。这是请求，配答应。

lines.text: Isn't this the room for the chemistry review?

options: No, I don't have a room.
It was supposed to be, but it's been moved to Room 204.
items.why: 否定疑问在求证。C 先确认原来是，再纠正。

lines.text: I heard you got the scholarship. Congratulations!

options: Thanks! I still can't believe it.
items.why: 祝贺配道谢。You're welcome 只配 Thanks。

lines.text: How about meeting at the café instead of the library?

options: I met her at the library.
items.why: How about 是提议。That works for me 是同意。

lines.text: You wouldn't happen to have a spare charger, would you?

options: I do, actually. It's in my bag.
items.why: 这是很客气的借东西的说法。回应要说有没有。

lines.text: What did you think of the guest lecture?

options: I think it starts at three.
Honestly, it was hard to follow.
items.why: What did you think of 问看法，而且是过去的事。

lines.text: The cafeteria's closed again? You've got to be kidding.

options: I know. That's the third time this week.
items.why: You've got to be kidding 是表示不满和难以相信，不是真的问对方在不在开玩笑。

lines.text: When is the deadline for adding a course?

options: The end of next week, I believe.
items.why: When 问时间。

lines.text: Do you want me to save you a seat?

items.why: Do you want me to 是主动提出帮忙，配接受或谢绝。

lines.text: Haven't you finished the lab report yet?

options: Almost. I just need to add the graphs.
No, the lab is finished at noon.
items.why: 否定疑问带一点意外：还没写完吗？B 说明进度。

lines.text: Sorry I'm late. The bus broke down.

options: Don't worry about it. We just started.
items.why: 道歉配 Don't worry about it。

lines.text: Why don't you ask the professor for an extension?

options: I might do that. Thanks for the idea.
Because the extension cord is too short.
items.why: Why don't you 是给建议。B 用 Because 当原因答，还换了 extension 的意思。

lines.text: This is the line for the financial aid office, right?

options: I think so. I'm waiting for it too.
items.why: 句尾的 right 是在求证，不是方向。

lines.text: How did your presentation go?

options: It goes to the third floor.
items.why: How did ... go 问结果怎么样。

lines.text: I was wondering if you could look over my essay.

options: Of course. When do you need it back?
items.why: I was wondering if you could 是客气的请求。look over 是「看一遍」。
